title: Resident GFN2-XTB plus two-Morse primitive Delta(ZAFF)
summary: Compose resident GFN2-XTB with a primitive correction whose stretches are the difference of a ZAFF-library-alpha QM Morse and a separate GFN2-third-derivative-alpha Morse.
gates: field atom order matches the LINK molecule
field carries the approved v3 two-Morse residual protocol hash
QM and GFN2 Morse alpha arrays are present and independently sourced
ZAFF charges are zero and van der Waals terms are absent
Delta(ZAFF) energy is zero at its reference
compose energy and gradient at each geometry
compose analytic resident GFN2 and primitive ZAFF Hessians when requested
coordinate_policy: LINK optimizes in its selected SMITH chart; the two-Morse Delta(ZAFF) evaluates frozen SMITH primitives at each Cartesian geometry.
backend_policy: Use resident matrix_gfn2.GFN2Calculator plus the approved v3 primitive Delta(ZAFF) artifact. Sum E, G and optional analytic H in the same Cartesian frame without electrostatic or van der Waals ZAFF terms.
